_doc: Chart narrative contract for index.html. Tokens {n}, {cutExp}, {cutPrep}, {slope}, {r2}, {nReg}, {nWhitespace}, {nExposed}, {sharePct} resolved at build time in harness/build_frontend.py.

scatter_hero.title: Exposure vs preparedness
scatter_hero.lede: Each dot is one scored entity on two axes the market does not yet publish together. Horizontal position is how large the non-firm bet looks from the outside; vertical position is how much data, product and capital sits behind it.
scatter_hero.read: Dots high on Preparedness but left on Exposure sit in whitespace — capable but under-deployed. Dashed lines are in-sample median cuts (exposure ≥ {cutExp}, preparedness ≥ {cutPrep}). Dot size tracks confidence; inner fill tracks measured share.
scatter_hero.so_what: The cluster in whitespace is where parametric capacity could land first — prepared balance sheets pricing a risk the damage trigger still misses.

mos_by_layer.title: Margin of Safety across the stack
mos_by_layer.lede: Carriers, intermediaries, assets and reinsurers carry different shapes of the same grid risk. Layer averages show where the margin compresses or opens across the value chain.
mos_by_layer.read: L1 carriers and L4 reinsurers tend to aggregate book-level exposure; L3 assets concentrate non-firm intensity at the connection.
mos_by_layer.so_what: When layer averages diverge, capacity is mispriced relative to where curtailment actually lands.

table_rankings.title: Margin of Safety
table_rankings.lede: Preparedness minus Exposure, sorted for the full scored universe. This is the headline number the scatter argues toward.
table_rankings.read: Large negative margin means exposure outpacing registers, products and capital. Measured % is the share of the score resting on registers and filings — not research prior alone.
table_rankings.stats: Publication gate: {sharePct}% measured/disclosed blend · PROVISIONAL below 60%
table_rankings.so_what: Rank order shifts as registers land; the construct — two axes and a margin — does not.

bench_mos.title: Scores across the carrier field
bench_mos.lede: Ranked bars compare insurers, syndicates, MGAs, brokers and assets on the active metric. Every bar opens the full sub-factor decomposition.
bench_mos.read: Switch metric to see whether an entity leads on exposure, preparedness, margin, or measured share.
bench_mos.stats: Filtered slice · click any bar for detail
bench_mos.so_what: Benchmark view is for relative placement inside a segment — not a standalone rating.

term_regression.title: MoS vs measured share
term_regression.lede: Each dot plots margin against how much of that margin rests on registers and filings rather than research prior.
term_regression.read: A positive slope would mean higher margin correlates with harder evidence — the opposite suggests the most exposed names are also the least measured.
term_regression.so_what: Until measured share rises, rank order should be read as directional — honest about what is still outside-in.

term_scoreboard.title: Scoreboards by layer and book
term_scoreboard.lede: Mean margin aggregated by structural layer or by book segment tag.
term_scoreboard.read: Toggle layer vs segment to see whether the gap is structural (L1–L4) or thematic (energy, data-centre, parametric).
term_scoreboard.stats: In-sample means · click a bar to filter the scatter
term_scoreboard.so_what: Segment gaps flag where product fit has not caught up to exposure concentration.

term_strategy.title: Strategy map · L1 carriers
term_strategy.lede: L1 carriers only, on the same exposure × preparedness plane as the universe scatter.
term_strategy.read: Distance from the median cuts shows strategic posture — earning the bet, exposed to it, sidelined, or sitting in whitespace.
term_strategy.so_what: Carriers in whitespace with high preparedness are the natural first targets for parametric deployment.

term_alpha.title: Whitespace alpha
term_alpha.lede: Highest margin entities in the whitespace quadrant — prepared but under-deployed on exposure the market still prices as damage.
term_alpha.read: Gap column is preparedness minus exposure for whitespace names only, sorted descending.
term_alpha.stats: Top whitespace targets · n varies by filter
term_alpha.so_what: These are the names where capacity could move without fighting an already-earned book.

term_compare.title: Head-to-head carriers
term_compare.lede: Pick two L1 carriers and compare margin, axes, measured share and quadrant side by side.
term_compare.read: Useful for syndicate vs composite or MGA-parent contrasts — same construct, different posture.
term_compare.stats: Compare pool · L1 carriers with scored profiles
term_compare.so_what: Relative placement matters more than absolute level while the index remains provisional.

term_swarm.title: Linked assets by carrier
term_swarm.lede: Each small dot is a linked L3 asset positioned by its own margin and exposure — a carrier-level portfolio swarm.
term_swarm.read: Select or scan carriers to see whether parent preparedness matches asset-level non-firm intensity.
term_swarm.stats: Segment-linked portfolios · click dot for asset profile
term_swarm.so_what: Diversified carriers can look prepared at L1 while linked assets concentrate curtailment risk.

term_quad_stack.title: Quadrant mix by carrier
term_quad_stack.lede: Stacked bars show what share of each carrier's linked book falls in each quadrant.
term_quad_stack.read: 100% stacked view — compare book shape, not absolute size.
term_quad_stack.stats: Linked L3 assets · top carriers by book count
term_quad_stack.so_what: A carrier earning it at L1 with an exposed L3 book is a different risk than the headline score suggests.
